declarations.description:
The time range control of an observability dashboard, after Grafana and Datadog. The trigger shows the active
range; the popup offers searchable quick ranges, an absolute range typed or picked on a calendar, recently used
ranges and the time zone. `nav` adds buttons that move the range one span earlier or later and zoom out to twice
its span, and `refresh-intervals` adds a refresh button with an auto-refresh interval.

Each end is a string, so a range can be written to a URL as it is and read back unchanged. Relative ends follow
Grafana: `now`, `now-15m`, `now+1h`, with units `s m h d w M y`, and `/unit` rounds to the start of that unit
(`now/d` is midnight, `now-1d/d` midnight yesterday); as `to`, a rounded end covers its whole unit. Absolute ends
are a date (`2026-10-20`, the whole day when it is `to`), a wall clock read in `time-zone` (`2026-10-20T09:00`) or
an ISO instant with an offset. `fromDate`/`toDate` and `resolve()` give the instants; the same parser is exported
as `resolveTime` and `resolveRange` for code that reads a range from a URL.

In the popup, typing a span such as `3d` or `15 min` in the search offers "Last 3 days"; Enter applies the first
match. Arrow keys move through the quick ranges. Auto-refresh fires `refresh` every interval and pauses while the
page is hidden, refreshing once when it is shown again.
declarations.name: TimeRangePicker

cssProperties.description: Space between the trigger, the zoom button and the refresh control.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker--gap

cssProperties.description: Behind a shift, zoom or refresh button under the pointer.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__control__hover--background

cssProperties.description: The trigger while its range cannot be read or ends before it starts.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__control__error--border

cssProperties.description: Between the segments of one control.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__divider--border

cssProperties.description: The zone abbreviation in the trigger.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__time-zone--color

cssProperties.description: The refresh control while auto-refresh runs.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__refresh__active--border

cssProperties.description: The dot shown while auto-refresh runs.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__live--color

cssProperties.description: Capped by the viewport; below 640px wide the two columns stack.
cssProperties.name: --c2-time-range-picker__popup--width

cssProperties.description: The From and To fields, which hold expressions.

members.name: msg
members.description: Interface text in the nearest `lang`, and that language for `Intl`; a `lang` change redraws.

members.name: to
members.description: End of the range, read as the end of its unit or day when rounded (`now/d`) or a bare date.

members.name: presets
members.description: Quick ranges offered in the popup, as `{ from, to, label? }` objects (JSON in the attribute). Unset, a standard list from 5 minutes to 30 days plus today, yesterday, this and the previous week and this month.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: IANA time zone wall clocks and calendar rounding are read in, such as `UTC`. Empty means the browser's own zone.

members.name: timeZones
members.description: IANA zones the popup offers to choose from, separated by spaces or commas. With fewer than two, the zone is only shown.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of the week, for `/w` and the calendar.

members.name: nav
members.description: Shows the buttons that move the range one span earlier or later and zoom out to twice its span.

members.name: refreshIntervals
members.description: Auto-refresh intervals offered next to the refresh button, such as `10s 30s 1m 5m`. Empty hides the refresh control.

members.name: refreshInterval
members.description: Active auto-refresh interval, one of `refresh-intervals`, such as `30s`. Empty means off.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the control, read before the active range.

members.name: fromDate
members.description: The start of the range as an instant now, or `null` when it cannot be read.

members.name: toDate
members.description: The end of the range as an instant now (the end of its unit when rounded), or `null` when it cannot be read.

members.name: resolve
members.description: The instants the range covers at `now` (default: the current time), or `null` when it cannot be read or is empty.

members.name: showPicker
members.description: Opens the popup.

members.name: hidePicker
members.description: Closes the popup.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Fires `refresh` with the range as it stands now, as the refresh button does.

members.name: presetList
members.default: [ ...['5m', '15m', '30m', '1h', '3h', '6h', '12h', '24h', '7d', '30d'].map((span) => ({ from: `now-${span}`, to: 'now' })), { from: 'now/d', to: 'now' }, { from: 'now-1d/d', to: 'now-1d/d' }, { from: 'now/w', to: 'now' }, { from: 'now-1w/w', to: 'now-1w/w' }, { from: 'now/M', to: 'now' }, ]
members.description: The usable quick ranges, recomputed when `presets` changes.

members.name: formatters
members.description: `Intl` formatters by locale and options: labels are written for every quick range on each keystroke in the search.

members.name: labelOf
members.description: The label of a range: its preset's, a "Last N units", a named range, or its two ends.

members.name: intervals
members.description: The offered intervals, plus the active one when it is valid but not listed, so the control shows what runs.

members.name: quickMatches
members.description: The quick ranges matching the search, led by a "Last N units" read from it (`3d`, `15 min`).

events.name: refresh
events.description: Fired by the refresh button and on each auto-refresh tick, with the instants the range covers then.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when a range is applied: a quick range, the absolute range, a shift, a zoom or a time-zone change. `detail` holds `from`, `to` and `timeZone`.
Fired when the auto-refresh interval is chosen in the control; `detail.value` is the interval, empty when off.
events.name: refresh-interval-change
